Vor- und Zwischenspiel: /: h e G D e :/
Well it's {h}headlights, white lines, black tar rivers,
they {e}dragging me ar{G}ound this {d}country as it {e}withers.
The {h}billboards, signposts, standing in the way,
tell {e}of the state of {G}nations {D}that we find to{e}day.
And we'll {G}play, and we'll {D}play and we'll {C}play.
To every {G}day, every {D}day, every day{C}, to every {G}day.

And in the front rooms of old towns far from the city
with beaten up guitars and hearts full of pity.
The people gather round singing songs from everywhere.
Torn from the nation, left without a care.

And we'll {e}rid this bloody {D}world for a {C}moment in a {G}word.
And we'll {e}rid this bloody {D}world cause:
/: the {C}words that you heard when you were {G}young will always stay,
the {D}one's that always stay make the {C}world go away. :/
Go {G}away.

Warm night, clear sky, European town.
Outside the bars singing their hearts out to a crowd.
With open boots, violin, banjo and a voice,
exiled buskers, happy with their choice.
title: The road
